name: Gokigen Lovely Days
original_name: ごきげんラブリーデイズ
source:
Gokigen Lovely Days is a dating sim where you can romance handsome anime boys who are actually bugs. While you can meet the bug man of your dreams and fall head over heels for him, the insect dating sim isn’t all holding hands and steamy love affairs. Instead of working through their troubles, you’ll be presented with a can of bug spray, courtesy of Earth Corporation, and you’ll be forced to kiss goodbye to your brief bug relationship.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dexerto.com/gaming/free-dating-sim-lets-players-romance-bugs-voiced-by-attack-on-titan-star-3373383/]Dexerto[/url]]
translation:
《Gokigen Lovely Days》是一款约会模拟游戏，你可以在其中与实际上是虫子的帅气动漫男孩谈恋爱。虽然你可以遇到你梦想中的虫子并为他神魂颠倒，但昆虫约会模拟游戏并不全是牵手和热恋。你不会解决他们的麻烦，而是会收到一罐由地球公司提供的杀虫剂，并且你将被迫告别你们短暂的虫子关系。

[编辑自[url=https://www.dexerto.com/gaming/free-dating-sim-lets-players-romance-bugs-voiced-by-attack-on-titan-star-3373383/]Dexerto[/url]]
